 The Brand Behind the Viral Lip Sleeping Mask Just Launched a 12-Day Advent Calendar
 Emily Way Thu, 29 October 2026 at 10:44 pm UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Courtesy Laneige Ready or not, the holidays are just around the corner—and that means advent calendar season is upon us! While most folks think of chocolate when it comes to Christmas countdowns, skincare advent calendars are becoming increasingly popular every year. For those of us who suffer from dry winter skin, luxury advent calendars like the editor-loved Beekman 1802 advent calendar are truly a lifesaver.
 But why stop at skincare when lips suffer just as much from the chilly weather? Enter: the Laneige advent calendar .
 Dubbed the "12 Days of Wonder," this skincare advent calendar includes a variety of offerings from the Korean beauty brand. Like other beauty calendars, the 2026 Laneige advent calendar offers a surprise skincare or lip care item each day. We got our hands on one and were gobsmacked by its gorgeous look and all the goodies stuffed inside. Here's our review of this year's cult favorite beauty advent calendar.

 Want to try a little bit of everything Laneige has to offer? This beauty advent calendar includes 12 of the brand's bestsellers.

 What is the Laneige advent calendar?
 The limited-edition Laneige advent calendar offers a gorgeous fold-out design that makes it ready to gift (or open yourself—no judgement here). Behind the book-like cover nests 12 colorful numbered boxes, each boasting a different skin or lip product from the cult favorite beauty brand.
 This Korean skincare countdown includes six full-size products and six mini products, all of which are Laneige bestsellers. We know what you're thinking and, yes, the beloved lip sleeping mask is included!
 Psst: Did we mention that it has a $235 value, but only costs around $149? Now that's a good deal.
 How we tested it
 As a former beauty counter worker, I still get excited about high-end skincare. So when I saw that the Laneige advent calendar dropped, I knew I had to grab one immediately. Like most popular advent calendars, this one historically sells out way ahead of the holiday season, so you'll want to place your order as soon as possible!
 Advertisement Advertisement Upon opening the shipping box and setting up my new advent calendar, I was absolutely awestruck. As someone who tests dozens of advent calendars each year, it takes a lot for a Christmas countdown to wow me. But there's no other way to say it—the 12 Days of Wonder advent calendar is gorgeous! Ribbons of soft color wrap around the outside, and the inside is even prettier with its numbered watercolor boxes on full display.
 I wasted no time unboxing each and every product then and there. I just had to see what was inside!
 SPOILER WARNING: Skip this next section if you don't want to know exactly what's in the 12 Days of Wonder calendar. After all, it's nice to be surprised each day!
 Without further ado, the Laneige advent calendar contains:
 Mini items
 Glaze Craze Tinted Lip Serum in Peach Glaze 
 Water Bank Gentle Gel Cleanser 
 Bouncy & Firm Eye Sleeping Mask 
 Water Sleeping Mask 
 Lip Sleeping Mask in Sweet Candy 
 Glowy Balm in Gummy Bear 
 Full-sized items
 Water Bank Cream Moisturizer 
 JuicePop Box Lip Tint in Jazzy Jam 
 Bouncy & Firm Serum 
 Bouncy & Firm Sleeping Mask 
 Glaze Craze Tinted Lip Serum in Strawberry Sprinkles 
 Lip Glowy Balm in Berry 
 My favorite inclusions
 I'm seriously impressed with the skincare and lip products in this advent calendar. If you're not familiar with some of these offerings, allow me to fill you in. The Bouncy & Firm Sleeping Mask is designed to wear overnight, giving it time to firm your skin, add glow and smooth its appearance. It's made with Laneige's Peony & Collagen Complex and peptides to revitalize and firm. And firm it does! I was amazed after my first use—it feels like I went to a spa for a facial.
 Advertisement Advertisement The Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Eye Cream features blue hyaluronic acid, coconut oil and niacinamide to brighten and depuff the undereye area, both in the morning and at night. As someone with chronic undereye circles, I was the most excited for this product. I can also confirm after several days of use that my puffy undereye looks and feels substantially calmer. Plus, I love the gentle cooling sensation from the gel-like consistency!
 And, of course, we have to shoutout the editor-loved Lip Sleeping Mask that has one job: moisturize your lips while you sleep. The brand's Berry Fruit Complex, along with Murumuru butter and vitamin C, help accomplish that. As soon as I received this in the advent calendar, I couldn't wait to plop some on my dry, chapped lips before bed. Just as we reported in our review, I woke up with a petal-soft pucker, which lasted through the next day. Win!
 Final thoughts
 After unboxing and trying out all that the calendar has to offer, I'm super impressed. While some advent calendars focus on inexpensive items for their full-sized items, Laneige didn't skimp at all. I was actually shocked that there was a full-sized version of both the Bouncy & Firm Sleeping Mask and Water Bank Cream Moisturizer, since both of those items are pretty pricey on their own. While I wish the lip mask would have been full-sized, you get a lot of product in the mini, so it still feels like an amazing deal.
 For folks who are new to the brand and want to try a sampling of their best sellers, the Laneige advent calendar offers a great value. The assortment spans several different areas of the face, so many of the products work incredibly well together. As someone with sensitive skin, I can also confirm that the formulas are gentle and non-irritating. Picking up this countdown is such an easy and cost-effective way to establish a new skincare routine if you don't know where to start. And, of course, it makes an absolutely show stopping gift for beauty lovers.

 The Laneige advent calendar is available on the Laneige website , Kohls and Sephora . It retails for around $150, but contains a whopping $235 in value. It also sells out every year, so order yours as soon as you can to ensure you can snag one!
 FAQ
 Which beauty advent calendar is worth the most?
 The Laneige advent calendar has a pretty lofty value of over $200, but beauty retailers like Sephora and Ulta often release high-end advent calendars ahead of the holiday season. One of our favorite high-end calendars is the Charlotte Tilbury advent calendar , which we've tested and loved in previous years.
 A few others we've tried and enjoyed include Benefit, Molton Brown and Korres. 
 How many days are in the Laneige advent calendar?
 There are 12 days in the Laneige advent calendar, but we don't blame you if you want to open them all in one go.
 Does Ulta Beauty have an advent calendar?
 Yes! Ulta carries a variety of Advent calendars spanning skincare, haircare and makeup.
 When did Laneige get popular?
 Laneige has always been a popular brand, but the brand received tons of notoriety when its Lip Sleeping Mask went viral on social media a few years ago.
